Speaker: Wraith
Text: You shouldn't be here. The grotto is dangerous for those who still have solid form.

Speaker: Kael
Text: We're passing through. Looking for the Fade.

Speaker: Wraith
Text: The Fade. Where things stop being things. I've drifted close to its edge. It calls to you — makes you want to dissolve.

Speaker: Wraith
Text: I know how to resist the pull. If you'll have a shadow at your side, I'll come.
